description: Masters the song's finished mix, or masters it again in another style (for example "louder": loud). The song needs a finished mix, from mix_and_master or an uploaded mix. The studio shows the progress and plays the new master, which replaces an earlier master made in the chat (downloaded ones stay).

preset.description: Mastering style. streaming = optimized for Spotify and Apple Music; optimal = balanced ("Standard"); loud = maximum punch and loudness.

songId.description: The song id from list_songs or create_song.

name: start_mastering
title: Master a mixed song
